cards.back: to be located at / situated in
cards.example: 中国位于欧亚大陆的东方。
cards.exampleTranslation: China is located in the east of the Eurasian continent.
cards.breakdown: 位：一个人（亻）站在自己的位置（立）上 · 于：表示'在……'的意思

cards.example: 考古证明中国很早就有原始人类。
cards.exampleTranslation: Archaeology proves China had primitive humans very early.
cards.breakdown: 证：用话（讠）说出正确（正）的事实 · 明：日月同辉，清清楚楚

cards.example: 中国大地上早就有了原始人类。
cards.exampleTranslation: There were primitive humans on Chinese land long ago.
cards.breakdown: 原：山崖（厂）下泉水（泉）流出的源头 · 始：女子（女）孕育生命的开始

cards.back: it is said / legend has it
cards.example: 相传4600年前有黄帝和炎帝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Legend says the Yellow Emperor and Yan Emperor lived 4,600 years ago.
cards.breakdown: 相：用眼睛（目）看着树木（木），你看我我看你 · 传：一个人（亻）把话一代代传（专）下去

cards.example: 黄帝部落和炎帝部落联合起来。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yellow Emperor's tribe and the Yan Emperor's tribe joined forces.
cards.breakdown: 联：耳朵（耳）一个接一个相连 · 合：许多人聚到一起（人+一+口）

cards.example: 两大部落打败了蚩尤部落。
cards.exampleTranslation: The two great tribes defeated the Chi You tribe.
cards.breakdown: 打：用手（扌）敲打（丁） · 败：用棍子（攵）打散了财物（贝）

cards.example: 炎、黄两大部落合并了。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yan and Huang tribes merged together.
cards.breakdown: 合：合到一起 · 并：两个人肩并肩站在一起

cards.example: 两个部落合并，形成了华夏族。
cards.exampleTranslation: The two tribes merged and formed the Huaxia people.
cards.breakdown: 形：用毛笔（彡）描出的样子 · 成：一件事做完，成功了

cards.back: archaeology (studying the past by digging up old things)
cards.example: 考古证明中国很早就有原始人类。
cards.exampleTranslation: Archaeology proves China had primitive humans very early.
cards.breakdown: 考：老人低头，仔细琢磨很久 · 古：十张口一代代传下来的老故事

cards.back: tribe (an early group of people living together)
cards.example: 黄帝部落和炎帝部落联合起来。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yellow Emperor's tribe and the Yan Emperor's tribe joined together.
cards.breakdown: 部：一个片区（阝）分成好几块 · 落：草木（艹）落下的地方，人们聚居的村落

cards.example: 黄帝之后，黄河常有水灾。
cards.exampleTranslation: After the Yellow Emperor, the Yellow River often had floods.
cards.breakdown: 灾：房子（宀）着了火（火），就是灾难 · 水：流动的大水

cards.example: 禹带领大家治理洪水。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yu led everyone to control the floodwaters.
cards.breakdown: 洪：很多水（氵）一起（共）涌来，就是大水

cards.example: 禹当了部落的首领。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yu became the chief of the tribe.
cards.breakdown: 首：一个头，最前面的 · 领：发号施令（令）的那个头（页）

cards.example: 尧、舜、禹带领大家治水。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yao, Shun, and Yu led everyone to control the floods.
cards.breakdown: 带：像一条腰带，把大家系在一起 · 领：走在最前面领头的人

cards.example: 他们先后治理洪水。
cards.exampleTranslation: They worked one after another to harness the floods.
cards.breakdown: 治：像治水（氵）一样统筹管理（台） · 理：把玉（王）上的纹理（里）梳理清楚

cards.back: to elect / recommend (someone for a post)
cards.example: 大家推举有才能的人当首领。
cards.exampleTranslation: Everyone elected a talented person as chief.
cards.breakdown: 推：用手（扌）往前推 · 举：大家一起用手把人高高举起来

cards.example: 新首领要有才能。
cards.exampleTranslation: The new chief had to have ability.
cards.breakdown: 才：刚冒出土的幼苗，天生的本事 · 能：像熊一样强壮，什么都能做

cards.back: abdication (passing leadership to a talented person, not one's son)
cards.example: 尧、舜、禹都是通过禅让当上首领的。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yao, Shun, and Yu all became chiefs through abdication.
cards.breakdown: 禅：像祭祀（示）一样郑重地把位子交出 · 让：用话（讠）谦让给别人

cards.back: slave (a person forced to work with no freedom)
cards.example: 商朝大批奴隶在田里耕作。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the Shang dynasty large numbers of slaves worked in the fields.
cards.breakdown: 奴：一只手（又）牢牢抓住一个女子，不放她自由 · 隶：被人管着、跟在后面的仆人

cards.back: large numbers of / a large batch of
cards.example: 大批奴隶集体在田里劳动。
cards.exampleTranslation: Large numbers of slaves worked together in the fields.
cards.breakdown: 大：张开双臂的大 · 批：用手（扌）一次比较、分出一大堆

cards.example: 奴隶在田里耕作。
cards.exampleTranslation: The slaves tilled the fields.
cards.breakdown: 耕：用农具（耒）在田地（井）里翻土 · 作：一个人（亻）动手干活

cards.example: 商朝的青铜铸造十分发达。
cards.exampleTranslation: Bronze casting was highly developed in the Shang dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 铸：把金属（钅）熔化后倒进模子，做成长久（寿）的器物 · 造：走（辶）到作坊里制作东西

cards.back: bronze (a metal used for tools and vessels)
cards.example: 商代的青铜器很有名。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shang-era bronze vessels are very famous.
cards.breakdown: 青：像草木初生的那种颜色 · 铜：一种金属（钅），读音同'同'

cards.back: power / influence (of a state or group)
cards.example: 商朝势力东到大海，西到陕西。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shang power reached east to the sea and west to Shaanxi.
cards.breakdown: 势：用力量（力）造成的态势 · 力：一条用力的肌肉

cards.example: 当时的青铜铸造已十分发达。
cards.exampleTranslation: Bronze casting at that time was already highly developed.
cards.breakdown: 发：像箭一样射发出去 · 达：走（辶）得通畅，四通八达
